definitions.gloss: to reconsider; to think again; to think better of
definitions.explanation: To change one's initial decision or opinion after thinking again, often for the better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}って→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{思|おも}い{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I was about to leave in anger, but I thought better of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{思|おも}い{直|なお}して⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I was going to cancel, but I reconsidered and participated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}した。
examples.english: Her words made me reconsider my attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{諦|あきら}め→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}して⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I was about to give up, but I reconsidered and gave it another try.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞表|じひょう}→辞表：27086_jihyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}そう→出す：01087_dasu⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}し、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I was about to submit my resignation, but thinking of my family, I reconsidered and decided to keep trying a bit longer.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Pattern: [something]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}す

Can also be used intransitively (without object) to mean 'to reconsider.'

- {思|おも}い{直|なお}さない (negative)
- {思|おも}い{直|なお}して (te-form)
- {思|おも}い{直|なお}した (past)

USAGE:
Often implies reconsidering a negative decision or action and choosing a better course. Can suggest calming down from an emotional reaction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to reconsider one's thinking
- ⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to reconsider one's decision
- ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧{思|おも}い{直|なお}す - to think again once more

COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (think) + {直|なお}す (to redo/fix) → to rethink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す→考え直す：04591_kangaenaosu⟧ - to reconsider (more rational)
- ⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ - to review, reconsider
